name: dw-copilot-spike
description: P0 feasibility spike: expose Developer Workstation APIs to GitHub Copilot as language model tools and an @dw chat participant.

dwCopilot.apiBaseUrl.description: DW API base URL (through Kong). Dev only.

chatParticipants.name: dw
chatParticipants.description: Design Function Units in DW (P0 spike)

languageModelTools.name: dw_list_function_units
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List Function Units in Developer Workstation that the signed-in user can see. Returns id, name and status. Use it to find the functionUnitId before reading or applying a design.

languageModelTools.name: dw_get_format_spec
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return the authoritative JSON format (generatedData) for Function Unit designs: tableDefinitions, formDefinitions, actionDefinitions, processDefinition, etc. ALWAYS call this before writing generatedData for dw_apply_design.

languageModelTools.name: dw_get_tables
languageModelTools.displayName: DW: read tables of a function unit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the current table definitions (tables and fields) of a Function Unit. Use it to inspect the existing design and to verify after applying.

languageModelTools.name: dw_apply_design
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply a design (generatedData JSON in the format returned by dw_get_format_spec) to a Function Unit in DW. The server validates it; on validation failure the errors (with fieldPath) are returned — fix them and call again. scope selects which part is applied.
